name: Wei Zhao
bio:
Wei Zhao's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track but in the complex world of logistics. After graduating with a degree in Supply Chain Management from the National University of Singapore, he honed his skills managing complex supply chains for a multinational corporation. A chance encounter with a local racing team needing organizational expertise sparked his passion for the sport. He quickly recognized the parallels between efficient logistics and a successful racing operation.

Wei joined Reiza Racing Academy five years ago, initially focusing on streamlining their parts procurement and inventory management. His keen eye for detail and ability to anticipate potential bottlenecks quickly led to his promotion to Head of Operations. He believes that a well-oiled machine off the track translates directly into performance on the track. Wei is known for his meticulous planning, proactive problem-solving, and unwavering commitment to excellence.

What sets Wei apart is his data-driven approach to operations. He constantly seeks ways to optimize processes using analytics, identifying areas for improvement and implementing innovative solutions. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to inspire a sense of order and efficiency within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei has a slender build with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas and observations.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, with every item in its designated place.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
